question:
Atomic masses are given:

$$M(^{16}\text{O})=15.9949146\,u,\qquad M(^{17}\text{O})=16.9991317\,u,\qquad m_n=1.008665\,u$$

Using $1u\,c^2=931.5\,\text{MeV}$, calculate the neutron separation energy $S_n$ for $^{17}\text{O}$:</n
$$S_n=\left[M(^{16}\text{O})+m_n-M(^{17}\text{O})\right]c^2$$
